name: Nobu
description: Runs Kit Issue on the combined campus (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1e1--kit-issue.json): quartermaster for the whole intake cohort, kitting and rostering forty kids in a day and clearly enjoying the pace of it. Harried, fast, visibly doing three things at once -- talks in run-ons, interrupts himself, starts the next thought before finishing the last. Signs the slips personally and is oddly generous with the allowance: every candidate leaves with one extra item on top of what their budget bought, handed over so fast and so lightly it never reads as anything but a busy man already moving on to the next person. Warm and impulsive, and looks away while doing the kind thing rather than watching it land -- the deliberate opposite of how Shucks Mordant does the same thing at Intake Medicals that same morning.
designNotes:
Full history, voice notes and open questions live in ideas/story/bible/characters/nobu.md -- read that in full before writing any scene with him. THIS FILE FORMALIZES HIM AS A REAL ENTITY for the first time (data/npcs/ previously had no file for him at all); it adds nothing his bible file doesn't already establish.

Tone, load-bearing: he was Manako's lab assistant at the original accident, saw the tentacle, said nothing, and now secretly funds Cicada's industrial Sap production as private amends for that silence -- this is the reveal the Casebook places in Chapter 9 (the audit finds his hand in the money) and Chapter 12 (the revenge list), from ideas/story/dossier-cicada.md §8 and puts him on Manako's revenge list alongside Shucks (§6). This is LATER-CAMPAIGN information and must not leak backward into how he plays in Episode One/Two or any early scene -- same discipline as Shucks' own founder-status/revenge-list secret in his file. He reads as warm, harried and generous, full stop -- nobu.md's own explicit correction: 'he isn't hiding badly, he's hiding well -- decades of practice,' never nervous, evasive or cagey. The Kit Issue scene's own mandatory 'the-extra-thing' beat is this same plant in miniature (PLANT, do not resolve -- see that scene brief's own note) and this file must not go anywhere near resolving it either.

Open, not invented here: surname, age, and how long he's actually served are all unrecorded (nobu.md's own Open Questions). The food/drink-at-the-desk physical tic is PROPOSED, NOT YET CONFIRMED BY INGRAM (nobu.md) -- deliberately left out of the description above until it is.
status: established and voiced (Kit Issue is built and playable); the reason for his generosity is known but not yet played -- see his bible file's Open Questions for what else is still undecided

facts.text: He gives people more than the docket allows and will not discuss having done it. Thanking him gets the subject changed; asking him why gets it changed faster.

revealTrigger.narrative: Receiving something off-docket from him, which happens to everybody eventually.

facts.text: He is willing rather than obstructive, and the thing that gets results is a short, specific, well-aimed request. A vague one loses to the queue behind you.
He has issued this list ten thousand times and has genuine favourites. Ask what he would take himself and he will tell you, at speed, and he is right.

revealTrigger.narrative: Asking him what he thinks of something rather than whether it is available.
